integrity: The proof independently normalizes every source facet in the intrinsic affine metric, rewrites its offset as the permutahedral offset minus an explicit inter-block fragmentation statistic, derives a sharp all-facet lower bound, and proves the matching all-center upper bound and uniqueness from the singleton support halfspaces. Finite exact-arithmetic replay is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to m,n>=2 and to the Chapoton--Pilaud shuffle realization of the generalized multiplihedron. It does not cover arbitrary affine realizations, Forcey's different classical realization, circumradii, or John ellipsoids. A residual originality risk remains for an equivalent folklore observation in generalized-permutahedron language.
title: Block fragmentation exactly controls Euclidean facet distance in generalized multiplihedra
